Confusables and KG hints, Bicycle Laws and Safety

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A01
Bicycles travel with traffic and obey every signal, never against the flow [A01].
Why it matters: group traffic-obedience; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F03, sec13-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A01
One-way multilane roads push riders toward the left edge while slower-than-traffic riding keeps them at the right edge [A01].
Why it matters: group lane-position; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F04; confusables sec13-F06, sec13-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A01
Right turns flash left-arm-up or right-arm-flat, left turns use left-arm-flat, and stops drop the left arm [A01].
Why it matters: group arm-signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A01
Seats carry only designed riders, hitching to moving vehicles stays banned, and one hand always grips the bars [A01].
Why it matters: group rider-conduct; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F05, sec13-F11, sec13-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A01
Shoulders welcome riders, side-by-side pairs share a single lane without blocking cars, and shared markings guide placement [A01].
Why it matters: group lane-sharing; difficulty low; prereq sec13-F04; confusables sec13-F07, sec13-F08, sec13-F13 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A02
Night demands a white front lamp and a red rear reflector, with an optional red rear lamp allowed too [A02].
Why it matters: group night-equipment; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F14, sec13-F16 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A02
Helmets follow local law, routes fit rider skill, mirrors and bright clothing aid visibility, and rain hides hazards [A02].
Why it matters: group rider-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F17, sec13-F18, sec13-F19, sec13-F20 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0069]
